summary: Opt-in seeded shuffle of `gd-tools test` execution order: `--random-order` shuffles suites and the test methods within each suite, `--seed <int>` (and `[test] seed`) makes any order replayable, and the seed used is printed and recorded in the run artifact index. The shuffle runs after `--changed` narrowing and after the integration preflight, so expanded parameterized cases stay consistent with the manifest sent to Godot. `--shard` membership deliberately stays a round-robin over the deterministic discovery order, so sharded CI jobs under different seeds still cover every suite exactly once; randomization changes execution order only. Composes with --parallel, --exitfirst, --watch, --coverage and the suite/test/tag filters; off by default so existing runs stay byte-identical.
